info.name: Minimal PHP App
info.summary: Minimal Nextcloud PHP app: one page, one API route
info.description: Reference app for the nextcloud-php-app skill. It is the smallest app that still shows every moving part: an app id, a bootstrap class, a navigation entry, a page rendered from a template, and a JSON API route. Copy it and grow it.
info.author: Nextcloud AppAPI maintainers
